items.label: list_item
items.text: Understand the nomenclature of esters andbe able to draw their structural,displayed andskeletal formulae.

items.label: text
items.text: This is straightforward,but you need to remember these points:

items.label: list_item
items.text: Asfor carboxylic acids and acylchlorides(butnot amides),an esternamecontainstwowords.

items.label: list_item
items.text: The first word comes from the alkyl group joined to O.

items.label: list_item
items.text: The second word comes from the alkyl group joined to C.

items.label: table
items.text:
table A

| STRUCTURALFORMULA   | NAME             |
|---------------------|------------------|
| HCOOCH3             | methylmethanoate |
| CHCOOCH3            | methyl ethanoate |
| HCOOCH2CH3          | ethyl methanoate |
| CH;COOCHCH3         | ethylethanoate   |
| CHCOOCHCHCH3        | propyl ethanoate |

items.label: text
items.text: TableB shows the displayed and skeletal formulaeofsomeesters.

items.label: table
items.text:
| NAME              | DISPLAYEDFORMULA   | SKELETAL FORMULA   |
|-------------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| methyl methanoate | H H                | O                  |
| methyl ethanoate  | H O H H H          |                    |
| ethyl methanoate  | H H H H            |                    |

items.label: text
items.text: Esters are colourless liquids with relatively low melting and boiling temperatures, and are insoluble in water. All of the hydrogen atomsintheirmoleculesare attachedto carbonatoms,so hydrogen bonding is not possible.

items.label: text
items.text: Esters are present in perfumes,food favourings,solvents, anaestheticsandbiofuels.
